events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — John Tavares redirected a shot from Morgan Rielly into the net with five seconds left in overtime to lift the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 5-4 come-from-behind victory over the Anaheim Ducks in a fight-marred game Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: John Tavares scores with 5 seconds left in OT to lift Maple Leafs to 5-4 comeback win over Ducks

events.name: St. Louis Blues at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Adam Gaudette scored with 21 seconds left, Alexander Wennberg and Macklin Celebrini each had two goals and an assist, and the San Jose Sharks beat St. Louis 5-4 on Monday night to snap the Blues' three-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gaudette's goal with 21 seconds left helps Sharks win 5-4 to snap Blues' 3-game win streak
